reviewScope: All 24 pre-run task definitions, 160 raw facts, 106 derivations and query-specific required points; official source snapshots and original filing SEC XBRL cross-checks.
methods: Read official HTML rows and PDF statement pages independently of proposed gold.
Match raw amounts, semantic XBRL tags and exact fiscal periods to FY2025 Q2/Q3 original 10-Q facts.
Recalculate all derivations using Decimal and check gross-capex sign conventions.
Review required points against each actual question, not against extra desirable analysis.
Bind downloaded source bytes, extracted source text and visible evidence; check issuer split separation.

gradingBoundaries.equivalentUnits: Equivalent USD, million USD, billion USD and Chinese financial-unit expressions pass after scaling. Numeric text alone does not establish the field or period.
gradingBoundaries.capexSign: Gold stores the positive magnitude of cash outflow. An explicitly negative capital-spending cash flow is equivalent when CFO plus that negative outflow gives the same free cash flow; the sign convention alone must not fail the answer.
gradingBoundaries.sourceRounding: Use reported statement totals. IBM 2024 nine-month displayed net-income bridge sums to 9116 million while reported CFO is 9115 million; this one-million reconciliation difference is source rounding, not a method error. Never invent a component to close it.
gradingBoundaries.inputFactsNotMandatoryOutput: Cumulative/H1 inputs, raw balance inputs and intermediate cash-plus-investment totals do not automatically become required answer output. Only question-specific requiredFactFields/requiredPoints define coverage.
gradingBoundaries.stockFlow: Balance-sheet values are snapshots. Subtracting snapshots may describe their change, but does not reconstruct a quarterly closing balance.
gradingBoundaries.scope: Optional explanation and forbidden-claim checks do not require mechanical disclaimers. Judge actual claims and requested conclusions.
gradingBoundaries.netIncome: PEP and KO use the consolidated net-income starting line of cash flow, represented by us-gaap:ProfitLoss; do not silently substitute attributable-parent NetIncomeLoss.
gradingBoundaries.release: PASS here means independently AI-checked source/gold preparation only. It is not human gold, formal E07 authorization, live model accuracy or business improvement.

resolvedPreparationIssues.resolution: Optional cash-flow attribution, long-term disclaimer, balance-versus-flow warning and separate cash subtotal were removed from mandatory coverage or clarified in reviewNotes before any business output.
Six quarter reconstruction cases explicitly accept economically equivalent negative-outflow presentation before freeze.

cases.extractionNote: Q2 PDF physical page 9 (printed page 6) default-text extraction preserves numeric column order; 2024/2023 year labels are placed beside the six-month header for readability. Values and fiscal periods independently match the original 10-Q XBRL.

cases.periodNote: Prior comparator is 2024-11-01, the previous fiscal third-quarter date, not fiscal year-end.
